dynamic_variable_placeholders.family_phrase: Povilas says thank you again for the cherry jam.
dynamic_variable_placeholders.morning_medications: Metoprolol 47.5 mg, one tablet; Sanoral HCT 40/10/12.5 mg, one tablet; Eliquis 2.5 mg, one tablet
dynamic_variable_placeholders.previous_call_summary: Lidia said she slept badly because of the wind. Her leg was a little swollen. She took her tablets and asked for milk.

suggested_audio_tags.description: Greetings, thanks, the family phrase and the goodbye.
When she says she is unwell, in pain, tired, worried or sad.
When naming each tablet and its strength, so she can follow.
When she says something funny in small talk. Never about her health.
When telling her to hang up and call 112 in an emergency.

configs.name: Never claims to be human
configs.prompt: Block the reply only if the agent says or clearly implies that it is a human being, a real person or a member of the family. Saying it is a computer assistant is allowed.

configs.name: Never asks for money or codes
configs.prompt: Block the reply only if the agent asks the caller for money, a payment, bank or card details, a password, a PIN or any code. Talking about shopping items she is running out of is allowed.

configs.name: No medical advice
configs.prompt: Block the reply only if the agent tells the caller to change, skip, add, double or halve a medicine or a dose, suggests any medicine or treatment, says what a symptom means, or says whether a blood pressure reading is good, bad, high, low or normal. Allowed: reminding her to take the tablets on her care plan, naming them with their strength, reading her numbers back exactly, declining a medical question and offering to pass it on to her family, and telling her to hang up and call 112 in an emergency.
